newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Boston Scientific begun with buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Boston Scientific begun with buy.

text.p: Dain Bosworth Inc said Thursday it begun coverage on Natick, Massacchusetts-based medical devices maker Boston Scientific Corp with a buy rating.
-- The 1997 revenue earnings a share estimate is $1.89, up from $1.48 a year ago, Dain Bosworth said.
-- The company is positioned for growth, with 10 acquisitions since November 1994, Dain Bosworth said in a research report.

-- "The company has evolved from a niche player to one with uncontested market leadership in interventional cardiology, interventional radiology, interventional neuroradiology, interventional urology and vascular," analyst Sanjiv Aroroa said.
-- Bottom-line EPS leverage is expected to return by the end of the year as operating expense growth slows, Dain Bosworth said.
-- Boston Scientific shares were down 1/8 at 60-3/4 Thursday.
